## Type of change

- [ ] `feat:` New feature
- [ ] `fix:` Bug fix
- [ ] `test:` New or updated tests
- [ ] `docs:` Documentation only
- [ ] `refactor:` Code cleanup, no behaviour change
- [ ] `chore:` Dependency update, config change

Closes #<!-- issue number -->

## Checklist

### Code quality
- [ ] Code follows the project conventions described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, magic numbers, or mock/fake data
- [ ] All configuration values added to `backend/app/core/config.py` and/or `frontend/src/lib/config.ts`
- [ ] No `console.log` / `print` debug statements left in

### Anti-cheat (if gameplay code was changed)
- [ ] Correct answers are **never** returned to the client before submission
- [ ] No new fields added to API responses that could reveal answers
- [ ] Reviewed `_sanitize_question()` in `backend/app/routers/sessions.py` if new question type added

### Database (if schema was changed)
- [ ] New Alembic migration generated: `python -m alembic revision --autogenerate -m "..."`
- [ ] Migration reviewed manually and tested with `python -m alembic upgrade head`
- [ ] `backend/app/scripts/seed.py` updated if new game or default data added

### Frontend (if frontend was changed)
- [ ] `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit` — zero TypeScript errors
- [ ] `cd frontend && npx vite build` — clean production build
- [ ] No `any` types introduced
- [ ] `routeTree.gen.ts` not manually edited (auto-generated by TanStack Router)

### Tests
- [ ] New backend endpoints have tests in `backend/tests/`
- [ ] `cd backend && pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing` — passes with ≥ 90% coverage
- [ ] Coverage did not drop compared to `main`
